comparison.objective: Move a boxed mini-fridge with a hand truck by inserting the plate, tilting, rolling, standing it up, and withdrawing the plate; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR tests tool-under-load insertion, leverage, balance, rolling transport, and controlled unloading; candidate tests small-tool insertion, bimanual counterholding, fine collar rotation, locking torque, and iterative response tuning.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires the fridge upright at the loading spot with the hand truck removed; candidate requires two repeatable safe stops and retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: Material handling with a hand truck has different mechanics and outcomes from damper commissioning. No spec versions or tilt, route, stability, box-damage, and final-pose thresholds are provided.
